item.title: Daughter mourns Richmond mother shot and killed answering door
item.description: A Richmond mother is grieving after her 55-year-old mother was shot and killed at an East End apartment complex, marking the first of two homicides at the same location within a week.

item.title: Buddhist monks on Walk for Peace approach Petersburg on fourth day in Virginia
item.description: A group of Buddhist monks on a 2,300-mile Walk for Peace will make their way to Petersburg on their fourth day in Virginia.

item.title: VCU School of Nursing celebrates 50 years of nurse practitioner excellence at 'Leading with Heart' Gala
item.description: The VCU School of Nursing honored five decades of nurse practitioner education and celebrated its future at the "Leading with Heart" gala, with CBS 6 anchor GeNienne Samuels serving as MC.
